description.value: The Keg Steakhouse + Bar Alberni Street is a full-service upscale steakhouse connected to the Shangri-La Hotel in the heart of downtown Vancouver, a short ride from Stanley Park and the Robson Street shopping corridor. The location features four patios and a private dining room, The Georgia Room, which can seat up to 120 guests. Takeout and DoorDash delivery are available, and the restaurant is wheelchair accessible.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (5 spaces) at 43m; stands (2 spaces) at 65m; stands (12 spaces, covered) at 84m; stands (5 spaces) at 90m. Total: 24 spaces.
